comparison.objective: Knock a part from a sorting nest through the drop opening above the correct tote.
comparison.physical_skill: Impact or push-mediated ejection of an intact part with destination selection.
comparison.success_condition: Part leaves the nest through the drop-through that has the tote beneath it; body gives no strike, damage, or containment thresholds.
comparison.reason: This is the nearest impact/ejection neighbor, but it tests releasing an intact nested part into a selected chute, not coaxial mandrel placement, manufactured-notch fracture, retained-coil protection, four-fragment search, and final tray deposition.
